sam_sales: Heads up - POC customer (tenant 8801, trial key t-8801) sees repeated 429s during a CSV->embeddings job after ~12 minutes. Can we triage?

ravi_eng: Which endpoint and concurrency? Any failing request_id?

sam_sales: They POST to /v1/embeddings from a server that launches 8 workers, each sending ~3 req/s. Fail IDs: r_21aa, r_21ab.

oncall_micah: Sounds like per-route burst cap + trial token window. Quick fixes: reduce workers to 3-4 OR switch to the batch/bulk-embedding flow to cut requests.

sam_sales: Customer needs demo done today. Are temporary overrides an option?

oncall_micah: Yes - we can apply a non-SLA soft bump for a few hours. It will use trial credits (may trigger billing outreach if exceeded). I can apply +1.8x for 4h if you confirm.

poc_contact: Please do it now. We9re green for any trial usage.

oncall_micah: Applied. Expect fewer 429s in ~20s. If they still see errors, grab a curl with the failing request_id and paste here.

ravi_eng: I'll open an eng task to review token_accounting traces for r_21aa/r_21ab and propose presales guidance (recommended concurrency, batch size).

sam_sales: Thanks all  will relay to the customer and follow up on cost impact.
